note: Totals only. The by-family breakdown in the source is not drawn.

labels.untrainable only: Only unused vocabulary slots are bit-identical
labels.shared matrix: One matrix for input and output

explanations.token record: enough ordinary token vectors are bit-identical to the base to list the updated ones
explanations.untrainable only: those tokens cannot occur in training text, so they say nothing about the data
explanations.record, poor fit: some vectors are bit-identical, but the weight-decay shrink fits poorly; treat with care
explanations.changed throughout: the release follows its base, but no vector is left bit-identical to compare
explanations.not comparable: the token vectors are not a shrunken copy of that base's (e.g. Kimi-K2.5)
explanations.unchanged: all are bit-identical to the base, so no token stands out
explanations.shared matrix: tied embeddings: every vector changes and no record is kept (e.g. Gemma)
